description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Rite of Replication and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Rite of Replication copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game
